name: Naming: lantern::: names, no other engine named
body:
# Naming

Dean, 2026-10-30 (in-game UI thread): every Lantern name seen from Nyx starts with `lantern:::`, namespace names are lowercase and types PascalCase (`lantern:::ui:::Element`). Lantern is a tutorial repo and a prototype for a future engine, and as far as it is concerned no other engine exists yet, so nothing in it names another engine.

comments.text: Filed before starting, per Dean's standing rule.
